title: Robeco亚太权益主管：AI热潮还有多少空间？关键在于组合多元化
speaker: Joshua Krab

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, this is the question that everyone wants to ask, and I think this is, it's really difficult. I often think about when you have an edge in a stock. And two years ago, when these companies were trading at really, really low price to books, I think that was a bit easier.
segments.zh: 这是大家都想问的问题，确实很难回答。两年前这些公司市净率极低时，判断起来相对容易。

segments.en: At this point, as I sort of said, the valuations or the ratings are very low. The earnings expectations are pretty high, but they've got to come back a long way to not justify those ratings. So I think it's difficult at this point.
segments.zh: 目前估值水平较低，但盈利预期很高，需要大幅回落才能让估值显得不合理。所以现在判断难度很大。

segments.en: So I think you're either positioned, and I think the real question is, is how much weight or how much risk do you want to allocate to this part of the market? And then you can decide how much you want in physical AI, how much you want in memory, or how much you want in photonics. But I think it's really around that question about how much one leave allocated to this part of the market.
segments.zh: 关键在于你愿意给这个板块分配多少权重和风险。然后决定多少配置在实体AI、存储或光子学。核心就是配置比例的问题。

segments.en: And I actually think the really important question is here is, what are you doing the rest of your portfolio? Yeah, AI is not working. On the days when it's not working, what else have you got there that's going to provide you some diversification benefit? Because it hasn't mattered for a long time.
segments.zh: 真正重要的问题是：组合的其他部分在做什么？当AI表现不佳时，你还有什么能提供多元化收益？因为很久没考虑过这个问题了。
